tests.title: Norwegian tests online (A1–B2) — free practice | Komiks·Lab
tests.desc: Free Norwegian tests: level tests A1–B2, word order, listening, vocabulary, the alphabet and numbers. Every question comes from a voiced comic.
tests.lead: Every test here is built from the same stories you read: the sentences are real, the voices are the ones you have already heard. Nothing is invented for the exercise.
tests.lvlDTpl: Questions from every comic at level {l}: listening, word order, vocabulary and the meaning of whole lines.
tests.item1d: The most common mistake in Norwegian is not the word but its place. The verb comes second, and after an adverbial the subject and verb swap. Half the tasks are exactly those inverted sentences.
tests.item2d: You hear a line and choose what was said. The text is hidden on purpose — this is the skill the oral exam actually checks.
tests.item3d: Words from the comics, with pictures where a picture explains better than a translation.
tests.item4d: Recognising a word is not enough: you have to recall it and spell it out. That is what fixes å, ø, æ and double consonants.
tests.item5d: A short daily game that pulls in the words you have got wrong before.
tests.item6d: You write a short text and get the corrected version back, with the mistakes explained.
tests.basic1d: Letters and sounds, including æ, ø and å.
tests.basic2d: From zero to a hundred — by ear and in writing.
tests.examD: There is a mock exam with the same parts as the real one, and a placement test if you are not sure where to start.
tests.free: All tests are free. An account keeps your progress on every device.
